result.title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen computation by reusing shared layers, approaching larger models' capabilities with fewer parameters and easing the storage and deployment burden of stacking independent layers. However, repeatedly processing long visual sequences still incurs substantial compute and GPU memory costs. Visual token compression reduces these costs by shortening sequences. Existing methods mainly select original tokens directly or combine selection with aggregation. In looped models, the former may overlook changing token importance across calls and discard information needed later; the latter lack joint consideration of output changes across calls, limiting information preservation. We propose LoopZip, a training-free visual token compression algorithm addressing both issues. Visual aggregation builds a compact candidate pool before the looped backbone, and cross-invocation selection averages instruction attention from the first two existing calls of the same shared attention layer to retain tokens needed by both states. Weight-tied value correction then jointly fits shared visual-value adjustments to both pre-selection layer outputs, reducing output deviations across states. To validate LoopZip's effectiveness, we conduct extensive experiments covering two open-source looped VLMs, eleven benchmarks, and three pruning ratios. On LoopVL-1B, LoopZip retains 97.16% of the original model's performance at 50% pruning ratio and exceeds the strongest baseline by 5.36% at 87.5% pruning ratio. Across Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang, LoopVL-1B with LoopZip reduces peak allocated GPU memory by 58.36%-58.98% and achieves 2.01-2.47x end-to-end speedups over the original model.

AI.brief_summary: LoopZip 提出面向 looped VLM 的免训练视觉 token 压缩：在 backbone 前聚合出紧凑候选池，跨调用平均同一共享注意力层前两次调用的指令注意力来选 token，并用权重共享的 value 修正对齐两次调用的输出，在两个开源 looped VLM、11 个基准上降低显存与端到端耗时。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及循环式 VLM 迭代计算中视觉 token 重要性随调用漂移、早期选择可能丢弃后续所需信息的问题，与迭代深度的成本收益及视觉细节能否留在内部状态相关；其跨调用注意力聚合与输出偏差度量可供核查迭代推理中的信息坍缩与证据保留。
